_comment: Dated, falsifiable, no-stakes predictions. A threshold of {"from_metric": k} means 'the value of metric k in the as-of snapshot' and is filled in by compute.py. Each one is decided by the attested snapshot for exactly resolve_after (NEAR mainnet state at the first block of that UTC day, plus the first block 28 days earlier). contract/scripts/make_args.py turns them into add_prediction arguments.

predictions.claim: Total NEAR supply at the first mainnet block of 2026-12-31 is higher than at the as-of snapshot (no net burn at the protocol level).
The buyback wallet holds at least as much NEAR at the first block of 2026-12-31 as at the as-of snapshot (revenue is accumulated, not spent or burned from it).
Net issuance over the 28 days to the first block of 2027-01-31 is still positive (total supply grew).
In the 28 days to the first block of 2027-01-31 the three Intents revenue wallets gain less than half as much NEAR as total supply grows (burning all revenue would offset under 50% of issuance).
